causality_contract.availability_rule: 5m imbalance uses trades with event_ms <= bar close; BOS uses closes <= bar close; availability_time = signal bar close

dataset_policy.allowed: certified Binance UM aggTrades day(s) + same-provenance holding data
dataset_policy.contamination: 11G-C/D D1/D2/oos/gap sets are NOT used for 11G-K economics

deduplication.rule: one open position per symbol; signals while in position ignored; repeated bars of one setup count once

direction: both (long on bullish confirmation, short on bearish)

entry.rule: signal at 1m bar close from prefix-only features; market fill at next bar open
entry.timing: decision_time = signal bar close; entry_time = next bar open

event_definition: 5-minute trade imbalance DI = (buy-sell)/(buy+sell) from REAL aggressor trades with |DI| >= 0.6, followed within 10 bars by a same-direction 1m BOS (close beyond last confirmed opposite swing extreme).
execution_model: NEXT_BAR_OPEN (certified channel; SL-first ambiguity; single position)
falsification: With sufficient evidence (30+/3/2), pooled Cost-C expectancy <= 0, or no regime/execution robustness, falsifies the edge claim (reports FAIL, never rescues).
invalidation: Opposite-direction BOS close before entry, or 10-bar confirmation window expiry.

market_state.filter: none (all regimes; regime analysis is diagnostic only)

mechanism: Extreme one-sided aggressive flow marks institutional initiative; a same-direction break of structure confirms the move is accepted rather than absorbed.
negative_controls: time-shuffled trade order within windows (test-time control)
research_question: Does extreme REAL 5-minute aggressor imbalance followed by same-direction 1m BOS confirmation have directional predictive value?

stop.definition: Beyond the BOS broken level by 0.25x ATR14 on the risk side (structural, frozen).

target.definition: Fixed 2.0R from entry (frozen convention; no RR mining).

threshold_provenance: Imbalance 0.6 = 4:1 one-sided flow (strong-imbalance domain convention, fixed pre-observation). BOS 10-bar window = structural confirmation horizon (frozen 11G-A pattern). No threshold fitted to any outcome.
